cells.scene: A thoughtful adult scholar reads an advanced book beside several notebooks and a small library of serious books.
A learner looks puzzled at a dense page of complex symbolic equations while a scholar studies it intently, difficult-to-understand subject.
Two organizers coordinate a team moving a long table, each directing a different end with matching timing and cooperative gestures.
An adult gently but disappointedly reproaches a friend for forgetting a promised task, pointing to an unfinished chair, no harsh intimidation.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — intellectual (n.知识分子): A thoughtful adult scholar reads an advanced book beside several notebooks and a small library of serious books.
TOP RIGHT — abstruse (a.深奥的): A learner looks puzzled at a dense page of complex symbolic equations while a scholar studies it intently, difficult-to-understand subject.
BOTTOM LEFT — coordinate (v.协调): Two organizers coordinate a team moving a long table, each directing a different end with matching timing and cooperative gestures.
BOTTOM RIGHT — reproach (v.责备): An adult gently but disappointedly reproaches a friend for forgetting a promised task, pointing to an unfinished chair, no harsh intimidation.
CROP SAFETY: each scene has 20% white margins inside its own quadrant. Top drawings fully end ABOVE 45% image height. Bottom-row heads, hair, thought bubbles and main objects begin BELOW 58% total image height. Nothing crosses midlines. Sparse background detail, light watercolor.
review_notes: Intended cells visually reviewed for semantic sense, anatomy and crop. Unassigned filler quadrants in final atlas are not used.
